what_happened.line: The Select Board met jointly with the Sewer Commission, which agreed to pay its budgeted legal amount this year; a method for next year's budget will be reviewed.
The Board heard a briefing on the Complete Streets tier 3 grant application, which has a funding cap per application and may need extra town-funded work.
The Board approved a one-day beer and wine license and temporary food permit for the St. Boniface Oktoberfest.
Votes on the skate park letter of intent and the Matson Homes drainage easement at 63 Prospect Street were not audible in the captions.
The Board released two sets of executive session minutes, then set October meeting dates and entered executive session on litigation.

why_it_matters: Legal fees for sewer work were split between the sewer budget and town counsel, and how that cost is assigned next year affects what sewer users and the town budget, mostly taxes, carry.
The Complete Streets grant is capped, so any work beyond the covered components would fall to the town budget, mostly taxes, and could come before residents as a spending request.
watch_next: The October meeting schedule: the 9th kept, a workshop on the 16th, and the 23rd likely dropped.
The review of how Sewer Commission legal fees will be budgeted for next year.
